name: EXIT_SPEED_WINDING_ROAD_{speed}_KMH_YELLOW_TALL
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. Sheet W1-SA70AA (L or R): 900 x 1650 (the register's W1-SA70 is 1400 x 2400; this AA sheet is the one published; PNG W1-SA70.png), 2015, 1:15; R150, 15 / 45 (edge 15 + border 30). EXIT 150 D baseline 270, 375 (262/375/263); SPEED 150 D baseline 520 (250 pitch), 591 (154/591/155); winding arrow 440 high from 45 below (y 565-1005), 176 wide (362/176/362; detail: head 156 wide x 113, shaft 55, R16 bends) — traced from the sheet's filled artwork; 40 gap; speed numerals 300 E ('varies', dashed box, centred), baseline 1345; km/h 120 E lower case, baseline 1540 (195 below, 110 from the bottom): km 210 at 213, oblique stroke 120 wide 35 after it (210 tall, 65 from the bottom), h 74 wide 35 after that (213 right margin); the stroke is drawn as a parallelogram on the sheet's ink. Generated at 30 to 80 km/h in tens (advisory exit speeds; no example on the sheet). The sheet draws one hand; the other mirrors the arrow.
